notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, act June 15, 1935, ch. 261, title V, § 501, 49 Stat. 383, authorized President to allocate out of appropriation made to him by resolution of April 8, 1935, a sum for acquisition of areas for bird sanctuaries and refuges.

ancestors.heading: PROTECTION OF MIGRATORY GAME AND INSECTIVOROUS BIRDS
